name: Functional Analysis
description: Normed linear spaces: Normed linear spaces and their examples; Banach spaces and their examples; quotient spaces; finite-dimensional Banach spaces and properties. Bounded linear operators: definition and examples of bounded linear operators; properties of bounded linear operators. Dual and transpose: definition and examples of dual spaces; characterization of the dual of certain Banach spaces; definition and properties of the transpose of a bounded linear operator. Fundamental theorems of functional analysis: Hahn–Banach theorems; uniform boundedness principle; open mapping theorem; closed graph theorem. Geometry of Hilbert spaces: inner product spaces and their properties; Hilbert spaces and examples; best approximation in Hilbert spaces; orthogonal complements; orthonormal bases; dual of a Hilbert space. Basic operator theory in Hilbert spaces: Adjoint of an operator; self-adjoint operators; normal and unitary operators; projections. Compact operators: definition, examples, and basic properties of compact operators; spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators.
